documents.saffron-cultivation.md:
# Saffron cultivation

The fictional Terra-17 garden guide says saffron corms are planted 12 centimeters deep in well-drained loam. The inventory marker is CORM-17.
documents.water-motor.md:
# Water motor

The fictional Nacre-4 water motor starts with a blue lever and has a 42-liter tank. The inventory marker is MOTOR-42.
documents.battery-sensor.md:
# Battery sensor

The fictional Lumen-8 sensor accepts a 3.7-volt cell and reports charge every 90 seconds. The inventory marker is CELL-37.
documents.dryland-crops.md:
# Dryland crop notes

The fictional dryland plot grows barley and lentils. Its general advice is to use shallow rows and avoid waterlogged soil. The inventory marker is CROP-05.
documents.comet-calendar.md:
# Comet calendar

The fictional Oriole comet is visible in late autumn and has a 19-year cycle. The calendar marker is ORBIT-19.
